sections.html:
Tall stature = Height > 98th percentile (adult Male > 180 cm, adult Female > 167 cm)

  • ประเมิน น้ำหนัก, pubertal staging, arm span และ Target height = MPH ± 7

• Sex chromosome disorder: Klinefelter syndrome (XXY), XYY, XXX
  • Overgrowth syndrome: Sotos syndrome, Beckwith-Weidemann syndrome, Weaver syndrome
  • Syndrome with tall stature: Marfan syndrome, Homocystinuria, MEN 2B

Blackbook — Normal growth (BA=CA): Familial Tall Stature, XYY Syndrome · Accelerated growth (BA>CA): Obese BMI → Exogenous Obesity; Non-obese BMI → Normal puberty onset: GH Excess, Hyperthyroidism

Disproportionate: Klinefelter’s Syndrome (XXY), Soto’s Syndrome/ Cerebral Gigantism, Marfan’s Syndrome, Homocystinuria, Sex Steroid Deficiency/ Resistance, Acromegaly (Rare in Children)

Proportionate: Beckwith-Wiedemann Syndrome (Normalizing growth after birth), Weaver Syndrome, XYY Syndrome, Neurofibromatosis 1, Hyperthyroidism (Untreated/Severe)

• Growth hormone excess: Giantism
  • Hypogonadism: Hypogonadotrophic hypogonadism, Sex hormone def., Estrogen resistance
  • Hyperandrogenism: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia, Adrenal tumor, Familial glucocorticoid deficiency
  • Hyperthyroidism
  • Precocious puberty (in adolescent) — ดูกล่องย่อยด้านล่าง

sub.html:
• Gonadotropin dependent: Idiopathic, CNS abnormality
  • Gonadotropin independent: Functional ovarian cyst (include McCune-Albright syndrome), Testotoxicosis, Testicular tumor, Longstanding hypothyroidism

Precocious Puberty (early puberty onset, non-obese BMI, accelerated growth): Adrenal Tumor, Ovarian Tumor, Testotoxicosis, Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia

Constitutional: Constitutional Tall Stature (Early Bloomer)
